item.title: Somali piracy surges as the impact of the US-Iran war ripples outwards
item.description: Two ships were seized within four days last week raising to at least 13 the number attacked since January.

item.title: US strikes Iranian launchers on Larak Island in first known attack in weeks
item.description: Iran says the attack on Larak Island, the first known US strikes since late July, killed two people and injured two others.

item.title: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
item.description: The US space agency's telescope is starting a multi-year mission to create a new map of the universe and learn more about dark energy and dark matter.

item.title: Russia says it helped to repel Niger attempted coup
item.description: Soldiers tried to attack a key military base early on Saturday morning, authorities say, but were thwarted.

item.title: Head teacher evacuated 900 children minutes before Nepal floods hit school
item.description: Rajendra Dawadi leapt into action after receiving warnings over waters heading towards his school.
